description_en: Queries the most recent price of an Edge Node Service (ENS) instance
description_zh: 调用DescribePrice查询云服务器ENS资源的最新价格
kebab_example: aliyun ens describe-price --instance-type ens.sn1.tiny --ens-region-id cn-shanghai-unicom --period 1 --system-disk-size 20 --quantity 1 --data-disk-1-size 50 --internet-charge-type 95BandwidthByMonth --data-disks Category=cloud_efficiency Size=50 --period-unit Month --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePrice

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ENS node
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance.

- If you leave the PeriodUnit parameter empty, the instance is purchased on a monthly basis. Valid values: Day and Month.

- If you set PeriodUnit to Day, you can set Period only to 3.

- If you set PeriodUnit to Month, you can set Period to a number from 1 to 9, or set Period to 12
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长。

- 如果不指定PeriodUnit，则默认按月购买。目前只支持按Days和Month。
- 如果PeriodUnit为Day时，Period仅可以3。
- 如果PeriodUnit为Month时，则Period可以为1-9,12
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The size of the system disk. Unit: GB
parameters.name: system_disk_size

parameters.help_en: The size of the data disk. Unit: GB. If you specify this parameter, this parameter takes precedence over the Size property in DataDisks
parameters.help_zh: 数据盘大小，单位GB。如果此字段不为空，则以此段为准
parameters.name: data_disk_1_size

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth metering method of the instance. Valid values:

- BandwidthByDay: Pay by daily peak bandwidth

- 95BandwidthByMonth: Pay by monthly 95th percentile bandwidth

- PayByBandwidth4thMonth: Pay by monthly fourth peak bandwidth

- PayByBandwidth: Pay by fixed bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
ENS带宽计费方式。取值：

- BandwidthByDay：日峰值带宽。
- 95BandwidthByMonth：月95峰值带宽。
- PayByBandwidth4thMonth：月第四峰值带宽。
- PayByBandwidth：固定规格带宽
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

element_fields.help_en: The size of the data disk. Unit: GB
element_fields.name: size

parameters.help_en: If you leave DataDisk.1.Size empty, the value that you specified for this parameter is used
parameters.help_zh: 如果DataDisk.1.Size为空且本字段不为空时的则以本字段为准
parameters.name: data_disks

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle of the ENS instance. Valid values:

- Month (default):

- Day
parameters.help_zh:
查询云服务器ENS不同计费周期的价格。取值范围：

- Month（默认）：按月计费的价格单位。
- Day：按天计费的价格单位
parameters.name: period_unit
